hook.text: Your supplier says the deal is FOB Shanghai. You think they pay for shipping. They don't. Surprise bill.

buildup.text: Incoterms are standard trade terms that define who pays for shipping, insurance, and risk at each stage.

discovery.text: EXW means the buyer handles everything. DDP means the seller delivers to your door, duties paid.

twist.text: There are 11 Incoterms. Using the wrong one can shift thousands in costs and liability to the wrong party.

climax.text: Choosing the right Incoterm is a strategic decision that affects cash flow, risk, and landed cost.

punchline.text: Three letters decide who pays and who carries the risk.

quiz.question: What do Incoterms define?
options: Who pays for shipping, insurance, and bears risk
